verdict.gold_reason: Article 54(2)(c) requires the regulatory authority to have carried out an ex ante review of the applicability of a tendering procedure, including its conditions, and to have granted approval. The reference answer states this correctly. Its contrast with Article 36(2)(c), which says only 'assessment of the tendering procedure', is also accurate.

other_articles.why: This is the DSO equivalent. Its paragraph 2(c) requires an assessment of the tendering procedure and its conditions, but it concerns distribution operators, not high-voltage transmission operators.

verdict.ambiguity_reason: 'High-voltage grid company' maps to the TSO, which points to Article 54. The DSO Article 36 is a close sibling, but the wording of the question favours the TSO.
